blurb.en: Six-voice analogue drum synth through a master two-pole filter. Finger-drum it or hold the buttons and drone.
blurb.fi: Kuusiääninen analoginen rumpusyna kaksinapaisen master-suotimen läpi. Soita sormilla tai pidä nappeja pohjassa ja droneile.
blurb.sv: Sexstämmig analog trumsynt genom ett tvåpoligt masterfilter. Fingertrumma eller håll knapparna nere och drona.

pull.q: The voices all sound great, with some nice heft to them and offer a nice range of tone and timbre.

quotes.t: The filter doesn't close completely in either direction but like the rest of Gentle Wham has a super characterful sound.
Unfortunately there isn't any latching on the gate buttons which would be nice in order to more easily utilize the voices in drone mode.
